AccessToken.description: What may be shown of an access token; the secret is shown once, at creation.

Agent.description: An agent an organization may run: a model and the harness around it.

builtIn.description: Offered because the organization has set none up yet; an owner's own list replaces it.

enabled.description: Auto chooses only among the agents that are turned on.

id.description: A lower-case slug such as `claude-code`; sessions name it.

isDefault.description: What Auto uses before it has data; an owner sets it, and it is never set by brand.

needsOwner.description: Only a project owner may decide it, and policy never does: a changed value model.

oneOf.description: The card's own fields. `None` only for a card raised before payloads existed.

summary.description: What would happen; never a secret.

AuditEntry.description: An append-only record of a write or an approval. Holds no secret.

action.description: A registered action name, such as `project.create`.

target.description: The id of what it touched.

AuditPage.description: Newest first; `next` is the cursor for the page after this one.

AutoChoice.description: The agent Auto would start, and why in one line.

BudgetSummary.description: This month's spend against the caps.

valueNote.description: "No value set", or what one unit is worth, measured offline.

nowCents.description: The experiment's budget when the card was raised.

branch.description: `None`: the agent pushes to a branch of its own.

repos.description: One pull request per repo changed.

CardPayload.description:
What each kind of card asks, as typed fields. A card shows these, never text parsed out of
its summary, and an action that follows an approval reads what to do from here.

CostTier.description: "$", "$$" or "$$$", set from the agent's price.

Environment.description: Where an experiment's session may run.

builtIn.description: Offered until environments can be registered.

EvaluationTemplate.description:
A starting point for an experiment's evaluation in Customize, Evaluations. An experiment starts
from a copy; the template holds a command and paths, never a credential or data.

metric.description: What is measured, as a dotted path in the command's JSON output.

protectedPaths.description: Files an agent may never change, each as `repo:path`.

EventKind.description: Who spoke: a person, an agent, or the name of a tool an agent called.

EventPage.description: Oldest first. `next` is the `after` for the page that follows, or `null` when this is the end so far.

Experiment.description: The row of an experiment; its sealed definition belongs to the judge.

budgetCapCents.description: What all its sessions and judge time may spend, in US cents.

followPolicy.description: The composer's Mode: false asks a person for every card, true lets policy approve.

ExperimentSpend.description:
All the spend of one experiment since it began, against its budget. Spend rows name a session
and a kind, not a trial, so it is split by kind and by session, never by a trial's outcome.

ExperimentStatus.description: Sealing is the judge's; Watching and Regressed are derived, never stored.

ExperimentValue.description: An experiment's value: the model it was sealed with, its wins and what they add up to.

oneOf.description: The model of the newest sealed version; `null` is "No value set".

Identity.description: A person's identity at a sign-in provider.

KindSpend.description: What one kind of spend came to.

oneOf.description:
First message of a connection. Refetch what you show: it may have changed while you
were away. `cursor` is the `seq` the stream continues from.
The server cannot replay what was missed. Refetch everything you show.
A conversation item was added to a session. Fetch `GET /sessions/{id}/events?after=`.
The cards waiting for this member changed; `pending` is how many wait now.

LiveEvent.description:
One message on `GET /events/stream`: a hint that something changed, so a client refetches
what it shows. It carries ids, a count and a status, never words, a card's text or any
secret. The SSE `event:` name is the kebab-case `type` and the `id:` is a conversation
`seq` (on `hello`, `resync` and `message`), which a reconnecting browser sends back as
`Last-Event-ID`.

Me.description:
Who is signed in: the member, their organization and their role in it, and every
organization the same identity belongs to.

role.description: Their organization role, which is their default in every project.

oneOf.description: A person has one; a service account has none.

role.description: The organization role, the default in every project.

NewAgent.description: What an owner sets for an agent.

NewExperiment.description: What starts an experiment in a project. The budget defaults to the project's, then the organization's.

oneOf.description: A person's identity at a sign-in provider; none makes a service account.
A service account to issue it for (owners only); omitted: the caller.

NewValueModel.description: What a project owner sets: the model without its id, version or who set it.

centsPerUnit.description: Cents a year that one unit of the metric is worth; more than zero.

defaultBudgetCents.description: Default budget per experiment, in US cents.

monthlyCapCents.description: Monthly cap on all spend, in US cents. `None`: no cap.

OutcomeSpendLine.description: What was spent on trials that ended one way, or on none.

oneOf.description: `null` is Not measured: agent work that never reached `measure`.

Policy.description: What policy does with one card kind. Add credential only ever asks.

defaultBudgetCents.description: Default budget per experiment, in US cents.

monthlyCapCents.description: Monthly cap on the spend of its experiments, in US cents.

ProjectRole.description: A member's role in one project when it differs from the organization role.

ProjectValueModel.description: A value model as a project holds it: one per metric, a new version on every change.

Receipt.description: A body and the judge's signature over it. There is no unsigned receipt.

Report.description: The monthly Report for the organization or one project.

spendByOutcome.description: By what became of the trial each dollar paid for; Not measured is `outcome: null`.

spentNoWinCents.description: Spent on sealed experiments with no win, stopped or still going.

spentNotSealedCents.description: Spent on experiments that are not sealed yet.

spentWithWinCents.description: Spent on experiments that have a win.

Role.description: Ordered: a higher role may do what a lower one may.

Session.description: One agent's work inside an experiment.

note.description: Why it ended, such as "Stopped by Ada" or "Handed off to Codex".

oneOf.description: Set on a spawned session; a spawned session cannot spawn.

SessionEvent.description:
One item of a session's conversation. A tool call carries only its name, never its input or
output; the server stores the words people and agents said and nothing a tool returned.

oneOf.description: Who said it, for a person's message.

seq.description: Orders the conversation; a page is asked for by the last `seq` seen.

SessionIssued.description: A sign-in session; the secret is shown once and is also set as a cookie.

SetProjectRole.description: `None` returns the member to their organization role in this project.

oneOf.description:
Left out, the person's organizations are found from their identity: the oldest
membership signs in, and `GET /me` lists the rest.

StartSession.description: What starts a session in an experiment.

budgetSpent.description: True when the experiment spent all of its budget.

TokenIssued.description: An access token; the secret is shown once.

ToolCall.description: A call of one Antilog tool from an agent that is not in an Antilog session, such as `antilog mcp`.

call.description: Unique per call; sending a call again with the same id changes nothing twice.

oneOf.description: The session the calls belong to; the first call without one opens it.

followup.description: A measurement that was accepted: how it ended, in words. Never a holdout value.

spentCents.description: What the experiment spent in the range.

ValueBasis.description: How a dollar figure was measured, said wherever one is shown.

ValueFigures.description: Delivered, Pending, At risk and Return for one scope and time range, in US cents a year.

mergedWins.description: Wins whose pull request is merged and that count in Delivered or At risk.

pendingWins.description: Wins in an open pull request.

returnX.description: Delivered over spent; `null` when nothing was spent.

spentCents.description: Everything spent in the scope and range, experiments with no win included.

unvaluedWins.description: Wins with no value model: they count in no dollar figure.

centsPerUnit.description: Cents a year that one unit of the metric is worth.

setBy.description: The project owner who set it; never an agent.

unit.description: What one unit of the metric is called, such as `ms`.

ValueModels.description: The newest version of each metric's model in a project.

WinView.description: One win of one experiment version: its best Kept trial.

mergedAt.description: When its pull request was merged.

yearlyCents.description: What the whole win is worth a year; `null` with no value model.
